data.found_evidence: Four shards (a coordinator shard and three lane shards) flagged lost with at least 10 events in total, all appended between each shard's last commit and the revert (a window of a few minutes). Recovery was only partial, from the harness transcript (auto-notification prompts) and the item fold; heartbeat/triage lines cannot be told from meaningful ones afterwards. Related, not duplicates: B189 (commit the event log as part of the workflow: checkpoint verb, doctor warns on uncommitted events), B-hy-commit-events (commit at merge/complete/release/stop, done: leaves a window between commits), B-events-uncommitted-shards (doctor shows uncommitted shards, done), the forbidden-commands hook guard (chore-hooks-forbidden-commands, abandoned) and MTD-permissions (action-aware deny, open).
data.summary: Event shards are tracked files that agents append to uncommitted for minutes; a `git checkout -- .` (or restore/reset/stash/clean) in the primary checkout reverts them to HEAD and the appended events are gone for good (never in git), found only later as a 'Lost events' notice in brief/doctor after the owning shards had already grown past the old count.
data.title: A plain git checkout in the primary checkout silently discards uncommitted event-shard lines; nothing guards or commits them first

data.body:
Fixes bug Ba34619983b: Event shards are tracked files that agents append to uncommitted for minutes; a `git checkout -- .` (or restore/reset/stash/clean) in the primary checkout reverts them to HEAD and the appended events are gone for good (never in git), found only later as a 'Lost events' notice in brief/doctor after the owning shards had already grown past the old count.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-Ba34619983b --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed Ba34619983b --regression-test <test>` first).

data.body:
Fixes bug Ba34619983b: Event shards are tracked files that agents append to uncommitted for minutes; a `git checkout -- .` (or restore/reset/stash/clean) in the primary checkout reverts them to HEAD and the appended events are gone for good (never in git), found only later as a 'Lost events' notice in brief/doctor after the owning shards had already grown past the old count.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-Ba34619983b --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed Ba34619983b --regression-test <test>` first).

Suggested fix (extend B189, do not duplicate): (1) a pre-command guard in the harness hooks that refuses or asks before checkout/restore/reset --hard/clean/stash in the primary checkout while any tracked file under .ddflow/events has uncommitted lines, naming `ddflow checkpoint` first; (2) auto-commit event shards on a timer or every N appends (a knob, default on, commit only, never push); (3) doctor/brief: when a shard shrinks, list the lost lamport gaps and the harness-transcript recovery hint.
